verification.summary: The TIP-1090 precompile accepted an AWS NSM-signed attestation from the measured Zones prover enclave in block 89. The transaction trace and same-block replay returned identical verifier output; PCR0-2, public key, nonce, and registration challenge all match the captured build and runtime evidence.

trustAnchor.name: AWS Nitro Enclaves commercial-partition root certificate (G1)

enclave.moduleIdFormatNote: NSM zero-pads the hexadecimal enclave suffix; Nitro CLI omits that leading zero.

tempo.prTitle: feat(precompiles): Add AWS Nitro Enclave verifier

limitations: This proves that the TIP-1090 code accepted an authentic AWS Nitro attestation and returned the recorded claims.
PCR equality proves that the attested enclave matches the captured EIF build measurements; this demo does not establish an application-wide PCR allowlist policy.
The registration binds the attested public key to its challenge and signer; this demo does not execute or prove a Zones batch.
The EIF measurements identify this exact build, but Dockerfile.nitro-prover uses tag-referenced base images; rebuilding from source alone may not reproduce the same PCRs after those tags move.
The receipt commits successful precompile acceptance. Decoded return bytes are corroborating RPC trace and same-block eth_call evidence, not data committed into the receipt.
